handoff_instructions: M2-T21 done: Vapi's transfer-destination-request is now answered synchronously with the on-call employee's number, chosen by a new deterministic policy field on the receptionist.config business rule (transfer_employee_id, packages/domain/src/receptionist-config.ts). New core service packages/core/src/services/receptionist.ts:resolveTransferDestination(tx, params) resolves the tenant (provider_routes), loads the active config, and looks up that employee (must be active with a phone on file); in the SAME transaction it upserts the call communication and records communication.transfer_requested (event+audit) idempotently keyed on the communication id, so redelivery records the request exactly once -- no provider call happens inside the transaction (Vapi performs the transfer itself using the number we return). Anything out of policy (unrouted number, no employee configured, or one that is inactive/phoneless) creates an ops case (missing_data or policy_conflict) and resolves to 'unavailable' instead of guessing a destination. packages/workflows/src/receptionist-runtime.ts adds a thin resolveTransferDestination(db, params) wrapper (same runAs(RECEPTIONIST_RUNTIME) shape as resolveAssistantTurn), returning a TransferDestination or null. packages/integrations: VoiceProvider gained buildTransferDestinationResponse(destination | null); implemented in VapiVoiceProvider (Vapi's {destination:{type:'number',number}} wire shape, or {error} to decline) and FakeVoiceProvider. apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/voice/route.ts now answers call.transfer_destination_request synchronously (like assistant-request/tool-calls); webhook-processor.ts's DEFAULT_WEBHOOK_HANDLERS now maps it to answeredSynchronously (removed the old notYetSupportedSync stub) since the route already answers it before the background processor claims it. Deliberate scope decision: this task does NOT record the transfer *outcome* from Vapi's later transfer-update webhook -- that payload's exact shape isn't pinned by any doc/fixture in this repo, and done_when only requires the request/destination/escalation behavior, so recording a guessed outcome shape was left out rather than risk fabricating provider behavior (CLAUDE.md rule 14); a future task can add it once the real payload is confirmed. Tests added/updated: packages/core/test/receptionist.test.ts (resolveTransferDestination: unrouted number, missing policy, inactive/phoneless employee, resolved + idempotent-on-redelivery), packages/workflows/test/receptionist-runtime.test.ts (same behavior through the db-level wrapper), packages/integrations/test/vapi.test.ts (buildTransferDestinationResponse shapes + parseWebhookRequest normalization), packages/integrations/test/fixtures/providers.ts (new vapiTransferDestinationRequest fixture), packages/workflows/test/ingestion.test.ts (folded the old 'not handled yet' pinning test into the existing assistant-request/tool-calls it.each, now asserting the durable receipt settles 'processed'). All of pnpm format:check/lint/typecheck/test pass locally (core 320+, workflows 35, integrations 58, apps/web 24, all green). Next: M2-T22 "Link call outcome to lead and summary" (depends_on M2-T20, independent of T21) -- or M2-T23/T24 which also only depend on M2-T18.
